info.about: Shadows of the Damned is a 2011 action-adventure video game developed by Grasshopper Manufacture and published by Electronic Arts for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It was directed by Massimo Guarini, produced by Shinji Mikami and written by Suda51.
info.trivia: It began around 2006 as Kurayami, a survival horror project first conceived as a PlayStation 3 exclusive.
info.why: The 2011 PS3 and Xbox 360 discs were its only release until Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered arrived in October 2024.
